# Blinky: a minimal example application for the bootloader.
#
# Blinks an LED from the SysTick interrupt, which also proves that the bootloader has relocated the
# vector table correctly. Two variants with different blink rates are built, so that a successful
# update is easy to see (and to test): blinky-slow (1 Hz) and blinky-fast (5 Hz).
#
# Uses the application linker script generated by the bootloader build (LINBOOT_APP_LINKER_SCRIPT),
# so the image is linked to the application address of the configured layout.

set(BLINKY_LED_PIN "PA7" CACHE STRING "LED pin of the blinky example")
option(BLINKY_LED_ACTIVE_LOW "The LED of the blinky example is lit when the pin is low" OFF)

linboot_parse_pin(BLINKY_LED ${BLINKY_LED_PIN})

function(blinky_add name half_period_ms)
    add_executable(${name} main.c startup.c)
    linboot_port_setup_target(${name} APP)
    target_compile_definitions(${name} PRIVATE
        BLINKY_HALF_PERIOD_MS=${half_period_ms}
        BLINKY_LED_GPIO_INDEX=${BLINKY_LED_GPIO_INDEX}
        BLINKY_LED_PIN=${BLINKY_LED_PIN}
        BLINKY_LED_ACTIVE_LOW=$<BOOL:${BLINKY_LED_ACTIVE_LOW}>
    )
    target_compile_options(${name} PRIVATE ${LINBOOT_WARNING_FLAGS})
    target_link_options(${name} PRIVATE
        -T ${LINBOOT_APP_LINKER_SCRIPT}
        -Wl,-Map=$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${name}>/${name}.map
    )
    set_target_properties(${name} PROPERTIES LINK_DEPENDS ${LINBOOT_APP_LINKER_SCRIPT})
    linboot_add_firmware_outputs(${name})
endfunction()

blinky_add(blinky-slow 500)
blinky_add(blinky-fast 100)
